408:t_014:15.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Yeah! Quit wasting your time on stupid wars and listen to my soooong!!」

408:t_014:16.en:
$$レド$$
(These people risk their lives for others... They seek a resolution beyond a struggle for survival...)

408:t_015:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Answer me, $$ブレラ$$! What is the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ trying to accomplish with this?!」

408:t_015:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I'm a soldier. I follow orders.」

408:t_015:2.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Damn it! A puppet that only follows orders is more trouble than the quiet type!」

408:t_015:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That man isn't a puppet. He's human, just like us.」

408:t_015:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$ヒイロ$$ is right! He's just a big brother who worries about $$ランカ$$ and feels happy for her!」

408:t_015:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「The bastard controlling him is to blame! Once we take that guy down, he'll be back on our side like before!」

408:t_015:6.en:
$$レド$$
(Nothing should be holding me back anymore... And yet I'm... trapped in the way I used to live...)

408:t_015:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have received a polarized photon sequence. It is a standard $$銀河同盟$$ encrypted communication signal.」

408:t_015:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I identify it as a friendly unit.」

408:t_016:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have confirmed it is $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#robot$$.」

408:t_016:1.en:
$$レド$$
「That machine...! Is that you, Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$?!」

408:t_016:2.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「It's been a while, $$レド$$. I'm glad to see you're doing well.」

408:t_016:4.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「First, we'll break out of this situation. I'll cover you.」

408:t_016:6.en:
$$キャシー$$
「That $$マシンキャリバー$$'s pilot appears to be Ensign $$レド$$'s superior officer.」

408:t_016:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We've confirmed his intent to cooperate. Inform all units.」

408:t_016:9.en:
$$レド$$
(Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ was transported here just like me...)

408:t_016:10.en:
$$レド$$
(Once this battle's over, I can talk to him. He'll surely be able to answer my questions...)

408:t_017:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
「We have confirmed the destruction of both the $$バジュラ$$ group and $$サイデリアル$$'s forces.」

408:t_018:1.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Come with me, $$レド$$. We'll exchange information and assess our current situation.」

408:t_018:2.en:
$$レド$$
「I understand. Ensign $$レド$$ is returning to the $$クーゲル$$ unit now.」

408:t_019:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Wait! $$エイミー$$'s aboard the $$クォーター$$, too!」

408:t_019:2.en:
$$レド$$
「...I am... a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$...」

408:t_020:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain, we've confirmed a fleet making contact with Mr. $$フランジ$$'s group in the $$霧の海$$.」

408:t_020:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...Given the situation, Ensign $$レド$$'s superior officer is probably involved.」

408:t_020:4.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Will that man and $$レド$$... fight the $$クジライカ$$...?」

408:t_020:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Ensign $$レド$$ should have realized that the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ on $$翠の地球$$ pose little threat...」

408:t_020:6.en:
$$キャシー$$
「...$$チェインバー#pilot$$ is rejecting our calls.」

408:t_020:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We can't tell what they're after, but dealing with the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ remnants is our most urgent task.」

408:t_020:8.en:
$$キャシー$$
「I'll inform the $$フロンティア船団$$ of this matter, too.」

408:t_020:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What are they plotting now that they have the $$バジュラ$$'s power...?」

408:t_021:0.en:
$$青山$$
「That's impressive. We shot down 25 units in just one minute.」

408:t_021:1.en:
$$いぶき$$
「I'm sick of there being that many enemies to begin with, though.」

408:t_021:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「Every unit we shoot down brings Earth one unit closer to peace! Let's keep fighting with that belief!」

408:t_022:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Snap out of it, $$ブレラ$$! Remember $$ランカ$$!」

408:t_023:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Gah...! $$アンタレス１$$ is falling back.」

408:t_024:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Chasing him won't help, $$アルト$$. We have no way of restoring $$ブレラ$$ right now.」

408:t_024:2.en:
$$アルト$$
($$ブレラ$$... Are you going to stay like this and forget $$ランカ$$...?)

408:t_100:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「$$バジュラ$$! You don't have to listen to those idiots!」

408:t_100:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「What you need to listen to is my soooong!!」

408:t_101:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Wake up, $$ブレラ$$! You're not the kind of man who'd lose to something like that!」

408:t_101:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「My attack target is $$スカル４$$, a core combatant of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$.」

408:t_101:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「If you won't listen to me, I'll force you to listen!」

408:t_101:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll do it for $$ランカ$$, too!!」

408:t_102:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「What's wrong, $$ブレラ$$?! Is your love for $$ランカ$$ going to lose to some lousy $$インプラント$$?!」

408:t_102:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「But don't worry! I'll protect $$ランカ$$ even if you're gone!」

408:t_102:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「If that pisses you off, hurry up and snap out of it!」

408:t_103:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I question the purpose of participating in this operation when I had already left the unit's chain of command.」

408:t_103:2.en:
$$レド$$
(Am I... trying to abandon my mission and take refuge in life with $c, somewhere deep down...?)
